profile.headline: Software, AWS Certified, Data Science
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of full-stack experience building and scaling SaaS platforms across PHP, Python, TypeScript, and cloud-native AWS architectures. Proven track record delivering end-to-end software solutions spanning Laravel-based backends, MySQL-optimized data layers, Kubernetes deployments, and CI/CD automation with Terraform. Experienced collaborating cross-functionally in Agile environments, driving code quality, security-first development, and system reliability across healthcare and enterprise SaaS domains.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Shipped full-stack features for the Academy SaaS platform using PHP, Python (Django), and Angular within a multi-repo architecture, owning requirements through deployment and maintenance.
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines and enforced secure coding standards across PHP and Django codebases, improving deployment reliability and maintaining consistent test coverage.
• Collaborated in a 20+ engineer Agile team across sprint planning, task estimation, and biweekly product demos, driving delivery velocity and cross-functional alignment with Product and Design.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built ETL pipelines automating data integration, replacing manual processes and providing near real-time data access.
• Developed a web app for partners to upload data and sync via APIs. 
• Engineered a Salesforce drip campaign system with Twilio for automated messaging.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Built web and mobile applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL deployed on AWS Fargate, supporting clinical workflows in a healthcare SaaS environment.
• Designed and deployed a serverless chatbot using Node.js, AWS Lambda, and Twilio, enabling clinical staff to access SOPs via SMS with secure, scalable cloud-native architecture.
• Implemented OIDC-based authentication flows and designed REST API contracts to support secure, role-aware access across frontend and backend services.

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a React and Django platform on AWS for syncing autonomous robot image feeds with construction blueprints, using PostgreSQL for structured data storage and Docker for containerized deployments.
• Developed a TensorFlow-based safety violation detection model trained on 1,000+ annotated images, integrating model inference into the platform's backend API pipeline.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a Laravel and React application with D3.js visualizations for quantum tech market analysis, designing REST APIs and MySQL-backed data models to support structured company data.
• Wrote Python ETL pipelines using BeautifulSoup and third-party APIs with scheduled tasks to automate data ingestion and maintain data freshness across the platform.
• Developed an NLP pipeline using SpaCy for named entity recognition, integrated into the backend to enrich structured datasets with automated entity tagging.

positions.title: Data Science Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Contributed Python data preprocessing and modeling code across 10 research papers focused on fairness and interpretability in ML, maintaining reproducible pipelines and clean data workflows.
• Built PyTorch-based modules and Jupyter notebooks for an explainable ML course, supporting documentation and knowledge sharing for academic audiences.

honors.title: 1st Place - Techstars Business Competition
honors.description: Developed a real estate investing app showcasing important metrics (Cash on Cash, IRR, Cap. Rate, NOI, etc.), pitched the concept, recruited the team, and secured initial customers.

honors.title: Li Ka-Shing Executive International Scholarship recipient
honors.issuer: Issued by Li Ka Shing Foundation
